networkPolicy.desc: Everything except the video only media host

notes:
First stage, to watch the application on a device. Video is not blocked yet beyond mp4.kolhalashon.com.

From the binary and the server: the API is SOAP and ASPX over clear HTTP on www.kolhalashon.com (WebSrv/iPhoneServices.asmx, iPhone/GetMediaURL.aspx?FileID=N&FileType=audio|video|Video|hd). Today the server answers audio with an https URL under /mp3/ and video with an http URL under /mp4/, both on www.kolhalashon.com. Live streams use port 1935 on www.kolhalashon.com for audio (KHL_Mp3, LiveAudio) and video (KHL_Video, KHL_LiveVideo) alike. kol.kolhl.com is another base URL in the code.

So neither host nor port separates video from audio: blocking port 80 kills the API, blocking 1935 kills live audio. The difference is only in the path, and that path is in clear text, so a path rule on HTTP is the planned second stage.
